title: Yahadian language
extract: Yahadian is a Papuan language of the Bird's Head Peninsula of Southwest Papua. It is spoken in Yahadian village, Kais District, South Sorong Regency. Overall, Yahadian is poorly documented, with only enough data for a sketch of the language's structure. It is considered "endangered" by Ethnologue.
